correctness.rationale: Independent continuous endpoint pairs give a uniform rank matching with exchangeable edge labels. The Dirichlet gap moments give each conditional crossing/nesting probability mean 1/3 and second moment 2/15, and their mixed moment is 1/9. For distinct overlapping edge-label pairs this is exactly the joint success probability, hence gives Bernoulli independence; disjoint pairs have independent endpoints. Only the same-pair covariance −1/9 remains in the sum. For a single statistic, its pair variance is 2/9 and the n(n−1)(n−2) ordered overlapping distinct pairs each contribute 1/45, giving the stated variance and correlation (undefined at n=1). The first Hoeffding projections have joint covariance I/45; the canonical two-edge remainders are orthogonal off the diagonal and O(n²) in second moment. The bivariate iid CLT and Slutsky therefore give the stated independent Gaussian coordinates. A separate exact enumeration of n=2 through 6 agrees (replay: /workspace/branches/f2a0bb80-6f85-48ed-958d-580163425b90/independent_enum.py; output independent_enum.txt). The frozen script was inspected, not run; neither run proves the limit.
